eventDetail.about: Communication, Networking and Broadcast Technologies; Computing and Processing; Signal Processing and Analysis

eventDetail.scope: BDDM 2026 pay attention to theoretical and practical advances in data mining and big data analytics. The conference covers data mining algorithms, machine learning and deep learning for large-scale data, and distributed and parallel computing systems for big data processing. Key topics include graph mining and knowledge graphs, data stream mining and real-time analytics, as well as data security and privacy in data-driven systems.
